reviewer: Independent delegated reviewer; not the proposal author or Project Owner
decisionScope: Recommend a dormant semantic amendment; do not approve activation, HPG, scoring or DI gates.

roles.finding: Reported and identified financing population is a defensible separate metric. Exhaustive absence of financing in each opaque payable is a stronger assurance objective and must remain a distinct unavailable comprehensive population. Count current maturities once; include all identified applicable bonds, leases and other financing, with verified overlap.
roles.measurement: Retained balance-sheet HPG quantities are carrying amounts; no face-principal equality established. Versioned compatible measurement policies mandatory.

roles.finding: Unknown operating/miscellaneous liabilities must retain uncertainty and amounts, never zero or a presumption of nonfinancing. Small opaque amount/borrowings ratios are not upper bounds on hidden debt. No universal materiality threshold is justified by existing policy.
roles.readiness: Unresolved material safety uncertainty remains a separate scoring/decision blocker; this review gives no HPG materiality clearance.

roles.finding: Approved intent is sector-appropriate leverage, liquidity and solvency resilience. Reported borrowing basis can support that intent only with consistent lease/measurement basis, unrestricted cash, normalized/downside EBITDA and independent judgment. Exact documented versus executable dependencies are distinguished.
roles.selection: Prefer exhaustive verified comprehensive on compatible basis; otherwise verified reported population may satisfy an Owner-approved quantitative alternative. A smaller comprehensive population requires reconciliation; incompatible principal/carrying or mixed population/lease series cannot switch silently.

roles.finding: Dormant prototype remains under scripts/lib and review/tests. All 2297 prior tracked files and eight DB hashes unchanged. Five deterministic generated artifacts reproduced byte-for-byte offline. No other ticker receives admission.
